text: 羊有跪乳之恩，鸦有反哺之义
pinyin: yáng yǒu guì rǔ zhī ēn, yā yǒu fǎn bǔ zhī yì
literal: lamb · has · kneel · suckle · 's · kindness, crow · has · return · feed · 's · duty
natural: lambs kneel to suckle, young crows feed their parents in return

meaning.en: Even animals show gratitude to their parents, so human beings ought to repay theirs.
meaning.zh: 连动物都懂得报答父母的养育之恩，人更应当孝顺父母。

equivalents: gratitude is natural, even in beasts

examples.zh: 羊有跪乳之恩，鸦有反哺之义，我们怎能不孝敬父母？
examples.en: Lambs kneel to suckle and crows feed their parents in return: how can we not honour ours?

examples.zh: 奶奶常说羊有跪乳之恩，鸦有反哺之义，要我们记得报答父母。
examples.en: Grandma often says that even lambs and crows know gratitude, and wants us to remember to repay our parents.

usage.en: Based on old folk beliefs: lambs kneel when they suckle, and young crows are said to feed their aged parents (see 乌鸦反哺). It is a moral appeal, not natural history; literary, often seen in essays and family teaching.
usage.zh: 源于民间旧说：羊羔吃奶时跪着，小乌鸦长大后会衔食喂养老鸦（参见“乌鸦反哺”）。属道德劝导而非生物学事实，书面语，常见于作文和家教。

meaning.en: The truth cannot be kept hidden for ever; a secret will always come out.
meaning.zh: 真相是掩盖不住的，事情迟早会暴露。

equivalents: you can't keep a secret forever

examples.zh: 纸包不住火，他挪用公款的事终于被查出来了。
examples.en: The truth will out: his misuse of public funds was finally uncovered.

examples.zh: 别以为瞒得住，纸包不住火。
examples.en: Don't think you can hide it: paper can't hold fire.

usage.en: Typically a warning to someone trying to cover something up, or a comment after exposure; casual to neutral.
usage.zh: 多用来警告想掩盖事实的人，或在事情败露后感叹。口语至中性。

synonyms: 若要人不知，除非己莫为

pinyin: jǔ tóu sān chǐ yǒu shén míng
literal: raise · head · three · chi · have · gods · bright
natural: three feet above your head there are watching gods

meaning.en: Heaven sees everything, so one should not do wrong even in secret.
meaning.zh: 上天什么都看得见，所以即使暗中也不可做坏事。

examples.zh: 举头三尺有神明，做人要对得起良心。
examples.en: Heaven is watching from three feet above; one must live with a clear conscience.

examples.zh: 他想拿那笔不义之财，可又想到举头三尺有神明，终于打消了念头。
examples.en: He was tempted by the ill-gotten money but remembered that heaven sees all, and gave up the idea.

usage.en: Reflects the popular belief in watching deities; often paired with 人在做，天在看 and used to warn against wrongdoing, sometimes to mean simple conscience.
usage.zh: 反映民间对神明监察人间的信仰，常与“人在做，天在看”并说，用来警示不要作恶，也可指良心。

pinyin: huà hǔ huà pí nán huà gǔ
variants: 画龙画虎难画骨，知人知面不知心
literal: draw · tiger · draw · skin · hard · draw · bone
natural: drawing a tiger, you paint the skin but can hardly paint the bones

meaning.en: It is easy to capture a person's appearance but hard to know their real character.
meaning.zh: 画老虎容易画出外表，难画出骨骼；比喻看人容易看到表面，难知其内心。

equivalents: you can't judge a book by its cover

examples.zh: 画虎画皮难画骨，认识他三年了，我还是看不透他。
examples.en: You can paint a tiger's skin but not its bones: I've known him three years and still can't read him.

examples.zh: 画虎画皮难画骨，交朋友不能只看外表。
examples.en: In making friends you can't go by appearances alone.

usage.en: Usually said with the second line, 知人知面不知心. The point is that outward appearance does not tell you what is inside a person.
usage.zh: 常与下句“知人知面不知心”连用，强调外表不能反映内心。

pinyin: huáng jīn yǒu jià, qíng wú jià
literal: gold · has · price, feelings · no · price
natural: gold has a price but affection is priceless

meaning.en: Gold can be bought and sold, but love, friendship and loyalty cannot be measured in money.
meaning.zh: 金子可以论价，感情却无法用钱衡量。

equivalents: you can't put a price on affection

examples.zh: 黄金有价，情无价，这份友谊比什么都珍贵。
examples.en: Gold has a price but friendship does not; this bond is worth more than anything.

examples.zh: 他把祖传的信物看作黄金有价，情无价的纪念。
examples.en: He treats the family keepsake as priceless, a token whose sentimental value outweighs any gold.

usage.en: A modern remake of the older saying 黄金有价玉无价; popular on cards and in advertising and song lyrics. Casual to neutral.
usage.zh: 由旧话“黄金有价玉无价”改编而来，常见于卡片、广告和歌词。口语至中性。

pinyin: rén shēng zài qín, qín zé bù kuì
literal: life · lies in · diligence, diligence · then · not · lack
natural: a livelihood depends on diligence, and diligence never goes short

meaning.en: A person's life depends on hard work; whoever is diligent will never run short.
meaning.zh: 生计在于勤劳，勤劳就不会匮乏。

examples.zh: “人生在勤，勤则不匮”，这是奶奶留给我们家的家训。
examples.en: '人生在勤，勤则不匮': this is the family motto grandmother left us.

examples.zh: 他把“人生在勤，勤则不匮”写在书房墙上，天天提醒自己。
examples.en: He wrote '人生在勤，勤则不匮' on his study wall as a daily reminder.

story.en: In the Zuo Commentary, the general Sui Wuzi says that the people's livelihood depends on diligence, and diligence means no shortage: '民生在勤，勤则不匮'. The modern form replaces 民 with 人.
story.zh: 《左传·宣公十二年》随武子说：“民生在勤，勤则不匮。”今天常说成“人生在勤”。

usage.en: The original reads 民生在勤 (the people's livelihood), but 人生在勤 is now the usual wording; both can be quoted. Typical of family mottoes and school essays.
usage.zh: 原文为“民生在勤”，今多说成“人生在勤”，两种都可引用。常见于家训和学生作文。

pinyin: gōng fū bù fù yǒu xīn rén
literal: effort · not · let down · determined · person
natural: effort does not fail the determined

meaning.en: Those who work at it with determination will be rewarded in the end.
meaning.zh: 只要肯下功夫、有决心，终究会有收获。

equivalents: where there's a will there's a way

examples.zh: 功夫不负有心人，他练了三年，终于拿到了冠军。
examples.en: Hard work pays off: after three years of training he finally won the title.

examples.zh: 功夫不负有心人，我们的实验终于成功了。
examples.en: Perseverance has paid off: our experiment finally succeeded.

usage.en: Said as encouragement or on success after long effort; 功夫 here means 'time and effort', not kung fu. Neutral, common in school and sport.
usage.zh: 用于鼓励或长期努力后获得成功时。“功夫”指时间和精力，不是武术。中性，学校和体育中常用。

pinyin: bù jīng yī shì, bù zhǎng yī zhì
literal: not · go through · one · matter, not · grow · one · wisdom
natural: without going through a thing, you gain no wisdom

meaning.en: You only learn from experience; each hardship adds to your understanding.
meaning.zh: 没有亲身经历，就不会增长见识；每次磨难都会使人更聪明。

examples.zh: 不经一事，不长一智，这次失败让他成熟了很多。
examples.en: You learn nothing without experience, and this failure made him much more mature.

examples.zh: 妈妈说不经一事，不长一智，决定让我自己去试试。
examples.en: Mum said that experience is the best teacher and decided to let me try it myself.

usage.en: Often used after a setback, with the sense of consolation; the usual continuation is 吃一堑，长一智. 长 here reads zhǎng, 'to grow'.
usage.zh: 常在受挫后用作安慰，常与“吃一堑，长一智”连说。“长”读 zhǎng，意为增长。

text: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准
pinyin: shí jiàn shì jiǎn yàn zhēn lǐ de wéi yī biāo zhǔn
literal: practice · is · test · truth · 's · only · standard
natural: practice is the sole criterion for testing truth

meaning.en: Only practical experience, not authority or theory, can prove whether an idea is true.
meaning.zh: 一种理论是否正确，只能靠实践来检验，不能靠权威或空谈。

equivalents: the proof of the pudding is in the eating

examples.zh: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准，方案好不好，试一试就知道。
examples.en: Practice is the sole criterion of truth: the way to tell whether the plan is good is to try it.

examples.zh: 科学研究强调实践是检验真理的唯一标准。
examples.en: Scientific research stresses that practice is the sole test of truth.

usage.en: A political and philosophical slogan from the 1978 debate in China on the criterion of truth, begun by a Guangming Daily article of that title. Formal; common in official language and textbooks.
usage.zh: 出自1978年中国关于真理标准问题的大讨论，起因是《光明日报》发表同题文章。书面语，常见于官方表述和教材。

pinyin: shuō de hǎo bù rú zuò de hǎo
literal: say · well · not · as good as · do · well
natural: saying it well is not as good as doing it well

meaning.en: Actions count for more than fine words.
meaning.zh: 漂亮的话不如实际行动。

examples.zh: 说得好不如做得好，别光喊口号，拿出行动来。
examples.en: Actions speak louder than words: stop shouting slogans and act.

examples.zh: 老师总强调说得好不如做得好。
examples.en: The teacher always stresses that doing well beats talking well.

usage.en: Used to urge people to turn promises into action; a gentle reproach to someone who only talks.
usage.zh: 用来催促人把承诺变成行动，对只说不做的人含轻微责备。

pinyin: shuō de bǐ chàng de hǎo tīng
literal: say · (particle) · than · sing · (particle) · good · to listen
natural: what he says sounds better than singing

meaning.en: All talk and no action: the words sound fine but the deeds do not match.
meaning.zh: 话说得非常漂亮动听，但做起来不是那么回事。

examples.zh: 他承诺得很多，可说的比唱的好听，一件也没兑现。
examples.en: He promised a lot, but it's all talk: not one promise was kept.

examples.zh: 别信他，说的比唱的好听。
examples.en: Don't trust him: he's all fine words.

usage.en: Said sarcastically of someone whose promises do not come true; casual, often sarcastic.
usage.zh: 讽刺说得好听却不兑现的人，口语，多含讽刺。
